2607.21419.title: PATS: Policy-Aware Training Scaffolding for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2607.21419.paper_summary: In long-horizon LLM agent reinforcement learning, weak policies often repeat similar failures, producing uninformative rollout trajectories and limiting effective policy optimization. Existing skill-centric methods improve exploration by optimizing, filtering, or internalizing reusable skills. However, they remain centered on the skills themselves rather than being designed as adaptive training-time support for the evolving policy. To address this, we propose a policy-centric training paradigm that reframes skills as a dynamic training scaffold. Our framework, Pats, converts rollout groups from the latest policy into evidence cards and uses task-specific evaluation to adjust the context used in subsequent rollouts. Concrete guidance helps weak policies to complete challenging tasks. As policy improves, redundant context is revised or removed to reduce reliance on explicit guidance while preserving useful rollout variation. The policy is optimized with environmental rewards using standard RLVR, and the training scaffold is discarded at deployment. On ALFWorld and WebShop, Pats improves over strong baselines by up to 18.6%. Across seven search-augmented QA benchmarks, it remains competitive while using 32.1% fewer prompt tokens than the baseline.
2607.21419.paper_summary_zh: 在長期視野的 LLM 代理強化學習中，弱策略經常重複類似的失敗，產生無信息的滾動軌跡並限制有效的策略優化。現有的以技能為中心的方法通過優化、過濾或內化可重用技能來改善探索。然而，它們仍然集中於技能本身，而不是設計為對不斷演變的策略提供適應性訓練支持。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一種以策略為中心的訓練範式，將技能重新框架為動態訓練支架。我們的框架 Pats 將最新策略的滾動組轉換為證據卡，並使用特定任務的評估來調整後續滾動中使用的上下文。具體的指導幫助弱策略完成具有挑戰性的任務。隨著策略的改善，多餘的上下文被修訂或刪除，以減少對明確指導的依賴，同時保留有用的滾動變化。該策略使用標準 RLVR 以環境獎勵進行優化，並在部署時丟棄訓練支架。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，Pats 在強基準上提高了最多 18.6%。在七個增強搜索的 QA 基準中，它在使用比基準少 32.1% 的提示標記的同時仍然保持競爭力。
